  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Floras Lake House is our family-run business of 35 years. We are located on Floras Lake, 17 miles south of Bandon on the Southern Oregon coast. Only a sand dune separates fresh water Floras Lake from the ocean. This unique, beautiful setting truly sets us apart. <br>Beachcomb for agates at the beach (1/4 mile away) or explore the scenic <a target="_blank" href="http://www.americansouthwest.net/oregon/floras-lake/state-park.html">state park trails</a>&nbsp;nearby. Relax on our sunny, wind-protected decks just off of your room, watch the kiteboarders on the lake or search for wildlife like the river otters, beaver, blue heron, osprey or our local bald eagles.&nbsp;</p><p class="" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">We are looking forward to your stay!<br><br>Reed Brady &amp; Kylie Zarmati <br>Josh  &amp; Makenzie Brady<br>Innkeeper Hailey Day</p></div>
